DEFECTS_FOUND.evidence: describeContextProvider(surfaces/reviews/context) -> {ok:false, code:'INVALID_DESCRIPTOR', error:'fill is not defined'}; S14 surface-contract exited 1; browser rendered the generic 'No domain context lens is bound' fallback instead of the Review lens

DEFECTS_FOUND.title: Issue Decision button could never record a verdict (payload-shape mismatch)
DEFECTS_FOUND.detail: The governed-input form posts {id, decision:{…}} but the reviews surface registers `reviews.supersede` BEFORE the controller composition, so the surface handler (which forwarded the payload verbatim and expects top-level newDecision) is the one that binds. With no top-level expectedDecisionId the domain compared current(null) !== undefined and reported STALE_EXPECTED_DECISION for every verdict in every state. m0's stricter/mapping handler never bound.
DEFECTS_FOUND.evidence: real button click returned 'Decision blocked: STALE_EXPECTED_DECISION' with record unchanged; m0's own availability predicate (which requires a basis reason) never bound
DEFECTS_FOUND.fix: supersedeOpts() payload-shape bridge in index.ts; availability and execution now read the SAME normalized payload

DEFECTS_FOUND.title: Reviews surface presentation layer was never mounted (dead code)
DEFECTS_FOUND.detail: presentation-surface.ts exports installReviewsPresentation and documents 'Called once from composeReviewsSurface', but nothing imported it. Consequence: the shared W04 head rendered EVIDENCE intake vocabulary (All records/Submitted/Returned/Prepared/Admitted) on the Review surface, and the pane/queue chrome plus toolbar command labels stayed English in an Arabic session.
DEFECTS_FOUND.evidence: LINEAGE before/after: responsive-1440-ar (04:59) leftText 'All records/Submitted/...' + toolbar 'Continue Review/...'; accept-1440-ar (06:21) leftText 'كل المراجعات/مطلوبة/...' + toolbar 'بدء المراجعة/...'

DEFECTS_FOUND.title: Mounting the presentation layer naively wedges the page under any non-English locale
DEFECTS_FOUND.detail: w04-rescue.w04SetPaneLabel rewrites #leftPane/#rightPane .phead h2 with hardcoded English on every one of its own observer passes; presentation-surface wrote the localized value. Both observers watch childList, so the two overwrote each other forever. Under AR the main thread starved inside ~4s and page `load` never fired (navigation timeout). Under EN both wrote the same string so no loop appeared.
DEFECTS_FOUND.evidence: diag under ar: ready='interactive' at 1.5s then evaluate() unresponsive at 3.5s; same page with the two pane-title writes removed: ready='complete' at 1.5s and 3.5s
DEFECTS_FOUND.fix: removed the two pane-title writes from projectChrome; those two nodes stay on the shared seam's value and are recorded as a hotspot rather than fought over

DEFECTS_FOUND.title: REVIEWS_PRESENTATION_CSS measurably degrades the Criterion Findings table
DEFECTS_FOUND.detail: A/B on the same live page: with the stylesheet applied the worst `.w04-record-table` cell wrapped to 10 lines and 9/9 cells exceeded 5 lines; with it disabled 5 lines and 0/9. Root: `table.w04-record-table{min-width:0}` plus 34px inline paddings inside a ~342px split.
DEFECTS_FOUND.evidence: probe_ab: WITH maxLines=10 cellsOver5=9/9; WITHOUT maxLines=5 cellsOver5=0/9 (1440x1000)
DEFECTS_FOUND.fix: withheld the stylesheet (applyStyle:false). The projection ships, the craft CSS does not.

ROOT_CAUSE: Two independent ownership gaps inside the Reviews root: (a) missing `fill` import and a payload-shape contract mismatch in index.ts; (b) presentation-surface.ts — the surface's own locale/queue projection — was never wired, and one of its two responsibilities (pane-title writes) collides with the shared W04 seam's ownership.

index.ts: supersedeOpts() payload-shape bridge so the governed-input form's {id, decision:{…}} reaches domain.supersede() with a correct CAS; availability and execution share one normalization
index.ts: call installReviewsPresentation({commandBus, applyStyle:false}) from composeReviewsSurface
presentation-surface.ts: import from ./i18n.js instead of ./index.js (removes a latent module cycle)
presentation-surface.ts: gate ensureStyle() behind styleEnabled so the measured-harmful stylesheet can be withheld without forking the module
presentation-surface.ts: stop writing #leftPane/#rightPane .phead h2 (shared seam owns those nodes; writing them wedges the page)
presentation-surface.ts: do not consume the locale until the command owner exists (otherwise labels are marked projected before they can be claimed)
